A fresh cross-branch falsification proved a document-scope claim can publish a main-tagged event carrying the feature branch revision and digest, allowing the editor to display the wrong branch. The shared client also accepts contradictory success receipts. One bounded correction can close these gaps without entering Slice 3.

worker_package.objective: Correct and prove the complete Slice 2 boundary without expanding scope. Make every persisted and published control event carry a stable revision/digest coherent with its tagged branch even when document-global and addressed branch revisions diverge; ensure editor control traffic can never load another branch's immutable revision; return coherent stale revision/digest pairs; restore strict kind-specific response schemas with exact top-level/receipt equality and required claim fields; and add real-CLI acquire/retry/renew/release plus human revoke, verifier-only privacy, diverged-head restart, lease-state restart, idempotency, rollback, compiler-preview, and installed-Chrome falsification coverage.
